caveat: New immutable Week6 cohort; unvalidated partial-coverage experiment, not a betting edge. Baseline frozen.
method: Same Oct7 fitted practice/status residual-margin coefficients, no refit. Prior snaps through Week5 only; adjustment relative to no-injury row. No book/weather inputs or manual point bumps.
limitations: 25 of28 Week6 teams have reports; BUF,SF,WSH missing, so their games have no numerical adjustment.
Practice states for Sunday/Monday are not final game clearance.
IR provider inventory is not32-team transaction audit and long absences can already be in scores-only baseline, so double counting is possible.
Missing snap roles have zero contribution and are listed, not assumed healthy.
No fitted DNP play probability or teammate redistribution.
Totals and home-win probabilities stay baseline; Week5 experiment was worse than baseline and not promoted.
